existingPatternSpecReuseDecision.reason: The canonical G3B-U08 authority already materializes four source-backed semantic surfaces for each of the three P1-12 unknown roles. The new corpora add breadth evidence but do not establish a missing semantic family for P1-12 V1.

positiveWitnesses.sourceTitle: 數學_110 上學期_三年級_彰化縣_縣立中正國小_第二次段考(期末考)_翰林_試卷.pdf
positiveWitnesses.evidenceSummary: 40 bottles are shared equally among 5 classes and the question asks how many bottles each class receives; the source answer is 8 bottles.
positiveWitnesses.authorityUse: supports direct-role partitive wording and answer-unit surface only

positiveWitnesses.sourceTitle: 數學_110 上學期_三年級_彰化縣_縣立二水國小_第二次段考(期末考)_康軒_試卷.pdf
positiveWitnesses.evidenceSummary: 48 counters are shared equally among 8 people or among 6 people and the question asks the amount each person receives.

positiveWitnesses.sourceTitle: 數學_108 上學期_四年級_臺北市_市立成德國小_第一次段考(期中考)_康軒_試卷.pdf
positiveWitnesses.evidenceSummary: A box has 28 cookies and 60 boxes are given; the question asks the total number of cookies.
positiveWitnesses.authorityUse: supports totalAmount wording only; groupCount=60 is outside the current one-digit groupCount authority and does not expand it

positiveWitnesses.sourceTitle: 厉老师三年级数学思维讲义.pdf
positiveWitnesses.evidenceSummary: The average-number section explicitly states total divided by number of equal shares gives the equal amount.
positiveWitnesses.authorityUse: supports equal-share reasoning structure only; averaging terminology is not admitted as a new P1-12 context family

negativeBoundaryWitnesses.evidenceSummary: 45 puddings, 6 per box, asks full boxes and remainder.

negativeBoundaryWitnesses.evidenceSummary: 450 grams per bag, 8 bags, asks a kilogram-and-gram total.
